installation_summary: Installed the Regensburger KI-Führerschein (Next.js 15 web learning platform) in the workspace `/workspace` (pre-checked-out commit 0710674). The base image lacked Node.js, Bun, npm and yarn. Prerequisites installed: `unzip` via apt, then Bun 1.4.2 via the official installer (https://bun.sh/install) into `~/.bun/bin` (PATH updated). Dependencies installed with `bun install` (511 packages; `node_modules` present with 412 top-level entries). The dev server was started with `bun dev` (`next dev --turbopack --port 5173`) and verified serving at http://localhost:5173 (HTTP 200, title 'KI Führerschein Regensburg'). No `.env.local` was created; MongoDB variables are documented as optional and only affect the metrics/certificates features. A production `bun run build` was attempted and fails during page-data collection with 'Missing MONGODB_URI env var' for `/metrics` and `/api/certificates` — expected without a database and not part of the documented dev workflow. Final method: documented Bun workflow (bun install + bun dev).
additional_actions: Installed the `unzip` package via apt-get because the official Bun installer requires it and it was absent.
Installed Bun 1.4.2 from the official https://bun.sh/install script (the environment had no Node.js/Bun/npm/yarn), placing it in ~/.bun/bin and adding it to PATH.

Ran a production build (`bun run build`) as an extra verification step; it fails at page-data collection due to the optional MONGODB_URI env var not being set (expected behavior, not required for dev).
verification: Started `bun dev` and probed http://localhost:5173/ with curl. Result: `curl -s -o /tmp/idx2.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}" http://localhost:5173/` returned `HTTP 200` with 21102 bytes of HTML containing `<title>KI Führerschein Regensburg</title>`. Dev log showed `✓ Ready in 993ms`, `✓ Compiled / in 6.8s`, `GET / 200 in 7272ms`. Exit code 0. Dev server process `next dev` running (pid 1365).
